content: Meta is planning to release the last OS update for its Quest 2 and Quest Pro VR headsets by March 2027, the company announced today. The last OS update for those devices is planned to be v213, and after that, Meta will continue to ship security patches and critical bug fixes through the end of 2027. Apps that support the Quest 2 or Quest Pro can also be submitted through December 2027, Meta says. Meta is calling the Quest 3 and 3S “now the baseline for Meta VR gamers.” The company is announcing this shift ahead of the planned release of its new VR Glasses, which are set to launch sometime in spring 2027. “Quest 2 and Quest Pro laid the foundation for this platform, and millions of people still play on them,” Meta says. “Quest 3 and Quest 3S give your apps more performance headroom and mixed reality built in, and apps built for them carry forward to Meta VR Glasses, which run on the same OS and SDKs.” Meta launched the Quest 2 in 2020 and the Quest Pro in 2022. It discontinued both products in 2024.

chineseContent: 该公司今天宣布，Meta 计划在 2027 年 3 月之前发布 Quest 2 和 Quest Pro VR 耳机的最新操作系统更新。这些设备的最后一次操作系统更新计划为 v213，之后，Meta 将在 2027 年底之前继续发布安全补丁和关键错误修复。Meta 表示，支持 Quest 2 或 Quest Pro 的应用程序也可以在 2027 年 12 月之前提交。 Meta 将 Quest 3 和 3S 称为“现在 Meta VR 游戏玩家的基准”。该公司在计划发布新款 VR 眼镜之前宣布了这一转变，该眼镜将于 2027 年春季某个时候推出。“Quest 2 和 Quest Pro 为这个平台奠定了基础，数百万人仍在使用它们，”Meta 表示。 “Quest 3 和 Quest 3S 为您的应用程序提供了更多的性能空间和内置混合现实，为其构建的应用程序继承了 Meta VR 眼镜，它们在相同的操作系统和 SDK 上运行。” Meta 于 2020 年推出了 Quest 2，于 2022 年推出了 Quest Pro。这两款产品均于 2024 年停产。
